label: Facebook Comment Scraper
title: Facebook Comment Scraper: Posts, Reels & Group Comments
metaDescription: Scrape Facebook comments and threaded replies from reels, videos, photos, posts and groups: text, reactions and author. Full pagination, no login.
intro: Paste Facebook post, reel, video, photo or group links and get every comment with threaded replies, reactions and author data. Cap the replies per comment to control cost. No login.
useCases: Analyse sentiment on a brand's posts or ads
Collect customer questions from a page's comments

faq.q: Is there an official API for Facebook comments?
faq.a: Only for pages you manage, or after Meta's app review for public content. This actor reads public comments on any post, reel, video, photo or group post without login.
Yes. Turn on replies and set a cap per comment to control cost; each reply keeps a link to its parent comment.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Facebook comments API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: Facebook post, video or reel link
liveDemo.hint: Paste a public Facebook post, video or reel link and press Run: the demo fetches the first comments live (up to 10). Commenter names are hidden.

officialApi: Facebook's Graph API returns comments only for pages you manage, or with the Page Public Content Access feature after Meta's app review. This actor reads the public comments under any public post, reel, video or photo.
